prompt.text:
Implement a new, self-contained TypeScript access directory.

Export a class `AccessDirectory` with this exact API:

- `enroll(userId: string, passcode: string): boolean`
- `authenticate(userId: string, passcode: string): boolean`
- `remove(userId: string): boolean`
- `listUserIds(): string[]`

A user ID is valid when it contains at least one non-whitespace character. A passcode is valid when its length is at least four characters. Every method must validate all supplied strings and throw `TypeError` for invalid input. `enroll` returns `false` without changing an existing entry when the exact user ID is already enrolled; otherwise it stores the credentials and returns `true`. `authenticate` returns `true` only for an enrolled user with the exact passcode. `remove` reports whether an entry existed. `listUserIds` returns the exact IDs in ascending lexicographic order. Returned arrays must be fresh, and callers must not be able to mutate internal state through them. Empty directories are valid and produce an empty list. Use only standard TypeScript/JavaScript facilities and export the requested API.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
